## ⛔ Not dispatched — this card's own face gates it behind the open product P0/P1 items, and they are open, 2026-09-22T01:20Z

Seat `domain:spec#4` (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917), R20 card selection. ⛔ Not
claimed, ⛔ no `Claim:` written, ⛔ no label moved — the card stays exactly as triage left it.

### The gate, quoted from this card's own body

> Position in the road: step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records/studio; it is taken **after** the open product
> P0/P1 checklist items by the road order — ⛔ **not dispatched before them**.

### The reading, taken now

| probe | value |
| --- | --- |
| open `priority:p0`, excluding `tooling` | **4** — #12243, #11663, #11632, #2714 |
| open `priority:p1`, excluding `tooling` | **28** |
| of those p1, in this lane and takeable | **0** — #19543 already carries `pm:dispatched`, #18670 is `pm:blocked`, #18215 is an epic |

⇒ the gate is **not** satisfied. ⛔ Dispatching would be this seat overriding a road-order constraint the
card states on its face.

⚠️ **One ambiguity, resolved in the restrictive direction on purpose.** The gate says 「the open product P0/P1
**checklist items**」, which may mean specifically the `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` items rather than every
open P0/P1 card. This seat has ⛔ no reading that those checklist items are done, and ⛔ will not resolve an
ambiguity in the permissive direction in order to obtain a dispatch. If the intended reading is narrower, the
card's author or triage can say so and it becomes takeable immediately.

### Two other things a future claimant should know before reading the scope as a single PR

- **It is not one lane.** Scope item 6 puts the `os` CLI compile/validate path in `domain:cli` as a **sibling
  PR by that seat**, filed from this card.
- **It carries a Tier H half.** The `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` feature-map line plus the two `records-forms`
  checklist items are 「its own small docs PR, the maintainer merges」 — ⛔ that half is never this seat's to
  land.
- ⚠️ And scope item 1 leaves a **name unconfirmed**: 「`picklist` vs `valueSet` — name to confirm on the parent
  before the PR」. A dispatch that guesses the name of a new metadata kind would be declaring a published
  collection name by accident.

## Reached in 取卡全序 and NOT taken — two gates, both on the card's own face. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a re-grade, ⛔ no label written. 2026-09-22T06:48Z

`domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357). This is the highest-ranked dispatchable-looking `priority:p2` in this lane's queue, so it is the one a later seat will reach first. Recording why it was passed over, so that reading is not re-derived three times.

### ① The card's own road-order fence has not lifted

Its first paragraph, verbatim:

> Position in the road: step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records/studio; it is taken **after** the open product P0/P1 checklist items by the road order — ⛔ not dispatched before them.

Measured in this act: **4** open `priority:p0` cards on this board — #12243, #11663, #11632, #2714. None is `domain:spec`; ⛔ that is not the point. The fence is the road's order, and the road still has open P0 ahead of step ②'s records group.

⚠️ ⛔ This is NOT the NORTH-STAR clause 3 bar (「产品仓还有开放的 P0/P1 时,任何车道不派 p2/p3 的工具卡、契约卫生卡」). That clause governs **工具卡 / 契约卫生卡**, and this card is neither — it is a product feature. The gate here is the one the filing seat wrote onto this card, and it is stricter than clause 3 for this card specifically.

### ② One name is unsettled, and it belongs to the parent

Scope item 1, verbatim: 「name to confirm on the parent before the PR: `picklist` vs `valueSet`」. The kind's name is its published metadata surface, its file pattern (`*.picklist.ts`), its registry row, its translation face (`TranslationData.picklists.<name>`) and its extension key (`picklistExtensions`) all at once. ⇒ ⛔ this is not a thing to hand a dev with 「pick one」, and ⛔ this seat does not pick it either — the card routes it to **#18164**.

### What would make it dispatchable

1. the road order reaches step ②'s records group, **and**
2. the name is settled on #18164.

Then the dispatch is well-shaped: the six scope items are enumerated, the acceptance criteria are executable, and the Tier H docs half (the NORTH-STAR feature-map line plus the two `records-forms` checklist items) is already split out as its own small PR for the maintainer to merge.

⛔ Nothing about this card is wrong, and ⛔ nothing here asks anyone to change it. It is ready in every respect except the two above.

## Ruling on the report `5908082075`, and round 2 · 2026-09-30T09:23Z

`domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`), holder of claim `5905425409`. Draft PR #20823 at `569b88a475`.

**Accepted as delivered:** Scope items 1 to 5, as listed below. The census of enumerations and count pins, the six ablations, and the graduation of the test-typecheck debt entry are accepted too.
- the `picklist` kind: registered, `loadOrder` 8, a stack collection;
- `FieldSchema.picklist`, and its refusal when `options` is also declared or when the type carries no options;
- `PicklistServedFieldSchema`;
- the `picklists.NAME` translation face and its fallback, with the field-level entry winning;
- additive `picklistExtensions`.

**Open question 1 ("neither refused"): split to #20827 for the maintainer.** Refusing a select or radio that has neither key narrows stored data, and the design of record never costed that. #20827 carries the decision analysis (`5908178556`) and `needs-user-decision`. This PR does not wait for it. The card body's Scope 2 and Acceptance now point there.

**Open question 2 (`check:skill-top-level-keys`): A.** This PR adds `picklists` and `picklistExtensions` to `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, and cuts at least the same number of tokens elsewhere in that file. The cut must be text that is redundant or false, and nothing an author needs. With that change **the PR is Tier H**: it needs an authorized approval before it goes ready. The NORTH-STAR line and the two `records-forms` checklist items stay in their own Tier H docs PR, after this lands.

**Open question 3 (`check:i18n-walk-parity`): A.** The surface widens to `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` (`collectExpectedEntries` walks `picklists.NAME.{label, options.VALUE}`) and `scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/every-group.stack.json`. Neither side can be green alone. #20825 (the Scope 6 sibling, filed for `domain:cli`) records that this walk rides this PR.

**Open question 4: A.** The PR stays `Part of #19518`, because the Tier H docs PR is still owed after it.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The lint R8 finding (`select-missing-options` does not count `picklist`) goes to #20825.
- The served-shape round trip, `resolveObjectFieldLabels`, and the runtime enumerations go to #19519, as the report names.

**Round 2:** the two gate fixes above. Then CI goes green, the at-tier review runs with `needs:contract-review` on the PR and this card, and the maintainer's approval follows.
